question: Two parallel plate capacitors have plate areas in the ratio $2:3$. The rate of change of electric field between their plates is the same. Find the ratio of displacement currents in them. Give reason.

options.A: $I_{D1}:I_{D2}=3:2$ because displacement current is inversely proportional to plate area.
options.B: $I_{D1}:I_{D2}=1:1$ because the rate of change of electric field is the same.
options.C: Since $I_D=\varepsilon_0A\dfrac{dE}{dt}$ and $\dfrac{dE}{dt}$ is the same, $I_D\propto A$. Therefore $I_{D1}:I_{D2}=A_1:A_2=2:3$.
options.D: $I_{D1}:I_{D2}=4:9$ because displacement current is proportional to $A^2$.
